description_for_human: Production-ready React components for ENS name registration and renewal, profile record editing, and subname minting and renewal on ENSv2.
description_for_model: ENS Components (@thenamespace/ens-components) is a React component library for building Ethereum Name Service (ENS) experiences. It provides seven drop-in forms: EnsNameRegistrationForm (full .eth registration flow), NameRenewForm (.eth renewal), EnsRecordsForm (on-chain profile record editor), SelectRecordsForm (wallet-free record selector), OffchainSubnameForm (gasless CCIP-Read subname creation), SubnameMintForm (on-chain subname minting), and SubnameRenewForm (ENSv2 subname renewal). Everything runs on ENSv2 by default; pass version={1} to SubnameMintForm only for parents on an old Namespace listing. Registration and renewal are paid in USDC or DAI, subname mints in the tokens the parent's activation accepts. Components integrate with wagmi, viem, and @tanstack/react-query. Theming is done via CSS custom properties prefixed with --ns-. Supports Next.js, Remix, Vite, and CRA. Full API reference is at https://enscomponents.com/llms-full.txt.
